description: This file defines a Python class 'TextFileReader' that supports reading and processing text files, including methods for reading lines, processing individual files, processing directories, and counting files with only deleted lines. It appears to be part of a larger codebase related to file processing and style checking.

classes.name: TextFileReader
classes.description: Supports reading and processing text files, managing file counts, and handling file reading operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TextFileReader with a filesystem and processor, setting counters to zero.

methods.name: _read_lines
methods.description: Reads a file at a given path and returns its lines as a list.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Processes a specified file by reading its contents and passing lines to the processor.

methods.name: _process_directory
methods.description: Recursively processes all files in a directory.

methods.name: process_paths
methods.description: Processes a list of paths, handling files and directories accordingly.

methods.name: count_delete_only_file
methods.description: Increments count for files containing only deleted lines.
